doc: The single source of truth for the cell token. Every surface (Rust pincher, WGSL shader, JS quilt canvas) is generated from this file. Hand-editing a generated artifact is a violation of the bit law.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: invariant state flags (blink, critical, learn, human-driving)

invariants: fields are contiguous; no overlap; no gaps
glyph|route|weight cover bits 0..24 exactly as the discussion's final ResonantCellToken layout
buzz is the top nibble: dissent rides the high bits, authority the low bits
